title: Stairway
intro: The same step, three times. And each step is itself a repeat. Put a repeat inside a repeat.
cs_note: [b]Nested loops multiply[/b]: an outer repeat 3 around an inner repeat 4 runs the inner body 12 times. That's why two nested loops over n items cost about n² steps.
hints: One stair is: 4 moves east, turn left, 2 moves north, turn right.
Put one stair inside [b]repeat 3 times[/b]. Inside the stair, use a repeat 4 for the moves east and a repeat 2 for the moves north.

A repeat inside a repeat: the outer repeat 3 runs the whole stair three times, and each pass runs the inner repeats in full, so the robot makes 3 × 4 = 12 moves east in total. That's 7 blocks, exactly the limit. Check that the outer count really says 3.
